product_brief: A framework for building blockchain applications, featuring modular architecture, ABCI support, and cryptographic primitives for consensus and transactions.
pqc_capability_description: Adds ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) post-quantum validator consensus key type and user account key support in v0.55.0. Includes SDK key wrappers, Amino/interface-registry registration, multisig support, mnemonic-based keyring creation/recovery, transaction signing/verification, and ante-handler signature-verification gas cost.
crypto_primitives: ML-DSA-65, secp256k1, secp256k1eth, secp256r1, BLS 12-381, Ed25519
key_management_model: Keyring-based (mnemonic, file, os, kwallet, pass, test, ledger), multisig support, validator consensus key rotation
pqc_roadmap_details: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) support added in v0.55.0 for validator consensus keys and user account keys.
signature_schemes: ML-DSA-65, secp256k1, secp256k1eth, secp256r1, BLS 12-381, Ed25519
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Breaking changes in v0.55.0 include removal of SIGN_MODE_TEXTUAL, x/protocolpool module, and sr25519 support. Key rotation requires migration steps.
